title: Children on Horses, Wardman Ranch Whittier - Vintage 1940s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: Three young children pose outdoors on two saddle horses alongside a dog at the entrance to a rural estate. A rustic roadside sign in the background reads 'A. WARDMAN / Headquarters Ranch No. 1 / La Casa En Los Arboles / W. GUY STEELE'. Aubrey Wardman was a well-known Southern California rancher, oilman, and philanthropist in the Whittier area. The older girl sits confidently astride the horse on the right, while a barefoot boy supports a toddler perched before him on the left horse.
